text:
maria: quick heads-up — onboarding for customer Argus completed the LoRA merge on branch cust/argus-lora. running their quick-eval pack and seeing weird truncation on long-context prompts (responses cut off mid-sentence). anyone seen this pattern before? @rahul @evan
rahul: can you paste a failing prompt + the merge commit hash?
maria: repro snippet: `prompt = 'User: Provide a 3-step plan... (very long) \nAssistant:'`
merge: `9f3b2c7`
logs: ```
2026-02-15T14:02:10Z INFO model:start gen seq_len=2048
2026-02-15T14:02:11Z WARN kv_cache:evicting prefix=1024
2026-02-15T14:02:11Z ERROR generation:stopped early token=50256
```
maria: happens on both fp16 and int4 quantized builds when we run the customer's eval set. shorter prompts are fine.
evan: hmm. int4 + LoRA merges sometimes change tokenization alignment if merge pipeline reorders embeddings. did you run tokenizer checksum? also any tokenizer overrides in the merge?
maria: no overrides, but we did apply stitch-rescale step in merge pipeline. checksum: `sha256: a3c1...f9b2` for vocab.bin (matches upstream).
rahul: can you run the quick-eval with kv_warmup=true and full_batch=false? curious if continuous batching + cold KV evictions are the culprit. run command: ```
./run_eval.sh --model cust/argus/merged:9f3b2c7 --quant int4 --kv_warmup true --batching full_batch=false --eval-set argus-longprompts.json
```
maria: starting that now. will post CI log.
ci-bot: build/runner-482 finished: eval pack started (job id 482).
maria: partial result (first 10 tests): ```
case 001: expected len 512 got 510 (truncated)
case 002: expected len 128 got 128
case 003: expected len 1024 got 1024
case 004: expected len 2048 got 2012 (truncated)
```
evan: that pattern (some long ones okay, some truncated) smells like dynamic KV eviction at a specific token threshold. which runtime are you testing on? hosted-dedicated gpu type?
maria: testing on dedicated gpus (A10x). runtime: rwd-runtime v2.8.3 with custom kernel selector.
rahul: try forcing `max_prefill=4096` in runtime config to avoid early eviction and re-run single failing case. also capture `kv_cache` metrics (hits/misses).
maria: ran single-case with `max_prefill=4096` -> no truncation, full output returned. kv metrics show evictions at threshold 1024 previously.
evan: ok looks like stitch-rescale combined with int4 kernel memory layout bumped effective KV size and runtime's eviction heuristics were too aggressive. two fixes: 1) adjust kernel workspace heuristics (patch queued) 2) add an automated quick-eval check for long-context token retention in our onboarding pack.
maria: filing a small PR for the heuristics change and adding the long-context test to argus quick-eval. will tag you both.
rahul: nice. for immediate customer impact, enable `max_prefill=4096` as a temporary safe config on their dedicated pool and schedule patch during next maintenance window.
maria: noted. I'll update the rollout plan and notify SE. :thumbsup:
evan: also add a note to the quantization playbook about stitch-rescale interactions with KV sizing — saved me a few hours.
maria: adding it now. thanks y'all.
